_about: JBL's EQ presets, from JBL Headphones 5.37.10 (jbl.stc.com): assets/eq/<file>.json per model (files), and standard_preset_eq.json for the models whose config names no file, the presets of each series (standard, groups by the product's serialName). Each preset: name, category (what the earbuds report and are sent), index (cmdIndex, the 41 command's preset number), gains (left and right master gain in dB, where not 0) and bands as [type, frequency in Hz, gain in dB, Q] (type 1 peak, 0 low shelf, 2 high shelf; docs/jbl/PROTOCOL.md section 11).
